statements.t: INVESTORS IN ARCC AND STOCKHOLDERS OF THE COMPANY ARE URGED TO READ THE PROXY STATEMENT/PROSPECTUS AND REGISTRATION STATEMENT, AND OTHER DOCUMENTS THAT ARE FILED OR WILL BE FILED WITH THE SEC, AS WELL AS ANY AMENDMENTS OR SUPPLEMENTS TO THESE DOCUMENTS, CAREFULLY AND IN THEIR ENTIRETY WHEN THEY BECOME AVAILABLE BECAUSE THEY WILL CONTAIN IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ARCC, THE COMPANY, THE TRANSACTION AND THE PROPOSALS.

Investors and security holders will be able to obtain the documents filed with the SEC free of charge at the SEC’s website, http://www.sec.gov or, for documents filed by ARCC, from ARCC’s website at www.arescapitalcorp.com, and, for documents filed by the Company, from the Company’s website at https://www.midcapfinancialic.com.

Information regarding the persons who may, under the rules of the SEC, be considered participants in the solicitation of the Company’s stockholders in connection with the Proposals, including a description of their direct or indirect interests, by security holdings or otherwise, will be contained in the Proxy Statement/Prospectus when it becomes available.

risks.t: delay in completing the Transaction or integrating the businesses of the Company and ARCC
(ix) the combined company’s plans, expectations, objectives and intentions as a result of the Transaction, including the integration of the Company’s portfolio

(xi) the ability of Ares Management to implement its future plans with respect to the combined company and to attract and retain highly talented professionals
(xii) the business prospects of ARCC, the Company or the combined company and the ability of their portfolio companies to achieve their objectives
(xiii) the expected financings and investments and additional leverage that ARCC, the Company or the combined company may seek to incur in the future
(xiv) the adequacy of the cash resources and working capital of ARCC, the Company or the combined company
(xv) the timing of cash flows, if any, from the operations of the portfolio companies of ARCC, the Company or the combined company
(xvii) general economic, political and market conditions, including changes in interest rates and credit spreads
(xviii) future changes in laws or regulations (including the interpretation of these laws and regulations by regulatory authorities)
